scenes.name: ColdOpen
scenes.brief: Black void. A single warm spark of light is born and breathes. Slow push-in through dust. Title EXPONENTIAL slams in after L02 with a bass hit, subtitle 'An origin story'.

lines.text: Every hero has an origin story.
Ours begins with an idea, and a curve.

scenes.name: FlatLine
scenes.brief: Chapter I. A vast horizontal timeline of human history in cold steel light; milestones (writing, printing press, electricity, the computer) light up, but the line barely rises. Camera tracks along it.

lines.text: For almost all of human history, progress crawled.
Writing. The printing press. Electricity. The computer. Each took generations to reshape the world.

scenes.name: Attention
scenes.brief: 2017. The paper title types itself. Words become tokens; every token fires attention arcs to every other token at once; a Transformer block assembles from light. The first warm light enters the cold world.

lines.text: Then, in 2017, eight researchers at Google published a paper with an unusual title.
Attention Is All You Need.
It let a machine weigh every word against every other word, all at once. They called it the Transformer.

scenes.name: Scale
scenes.brief: Scaling. A river of particles accelerates upward; a log-scale chart of training compute climbs through real milestones (GPT-1 2018, GPT-2 2019, GPT-3 2020 ...). Abilities flicker into existence as the river grows.

lines.text: Then came a discovery. Make the models bigger. Give them more data, more compute. And new abilities emerge.
The compute used to train frontier AI has grown four to five times every year, for more than a decade.

scenes.name: HeroBorn
scenes.brief: Chapter II: THE HERO. 2021: a small warm light in a dark city. The constitution: glowing principles (helpful, honest, harmless) engrave themselves. Particles converge into the emblem; at L13 it ignites with lens flare and shockwave: CLAUDE.

lines.text: In 2021, a small team founded Anthropic, with a simple conviction.
If this was going to be the most powerful technology in history, it had to be built safely.
So they gave their creation something new: a constitution. Principles to be helpful, honest, and harmless.
In March 2023, the world met Claude.

scenes.name: Powers
scenes.brief: The hero levels up. A HUD power-meter climbs across real Claude releases 2023 to 2026; abilities unlock with superhero stings (READ, SEE, CODE, COMPUTER USE, AGENTS). METR task-horizon doubling curve.

lines.text: And like every hero, it grew stronger.
It learned to read a whole novel in seconds. To see. To write code. To use a computer. To work for hours on its own.
The length of tasks AI can complete on its own has doubled roughly every seven months. Lately, even faster.

scenes.name: Enemies
scenes.brief: Chapter III: THE BATTLES. A cold storm gathers. Humanity's four ancient enemies form out of dark particles, each named in cold steel type: DISEASE, IGNORANCE, POVERTY, A WARMING PLANET.

lines.text: But a hero is defined by the battles it chooses.
And humanity's oldest enemies were still waiting. Disease. Ignorance. Poverty. A warming planet.

scenes.name: Battles
scenes.brief: Four vignettes, one per enemy, each a cold scene that the hero's warm light transforms: (1) a protein/DNA structure illuminated; (2) a constellation of learners lit by a tutor's light; (3) a map of the world where knowledge flows to every region; (4) the planet's energy grid and materials glowing clean.

lines.text: Against disease, Claude is helping scientists decode the machinery of life, and even discover new biology.
Against ignorance, a patient tutor for every curious mind. At any hour, in their own language.
Against poverty, the kind of expert help once reserved for the few, within reach of anyone who asks.
And for our planet, new tools to discover better materials, cleaner energy, and smarter ways to use what we have.

scenes.name: Exponential
scenes.brief: Chapter IV: EXPONENTIAL. The curve from every earlier scene returns and bends toward vertical; at L23 the letterbox bars retract and the frame opens to full 16:9. Camera rides the curve up into a city-sized datacenter of warm light: a country of geniuses.

lines.text: And now, the curve is bending upward.
Imagine a country of geniuses in a datacenter. Working not against us, but for us.
Decades of scientific progress, compressed into years.

scenes.name: Finale
scenes.brief: Dawn over Earth. The emblem rises like a sun; its light spreads across the night side, city lights ignite. Final title: CLAUDE, then 'For the good of humanity.'

lines.text: Power was never the hardest part. The hardest part is choosing to use it for good.
That is what makes a hero.
And this story is only just beginning.

scenes.name: Credits
scenes.brief: Reveal: the film was made entirely in code. Stats counter, stack credits, sources, independent-tribute note, then a cursor types 'How can I help?'

lines.text: Every frame you just watched was written in code, by Claude.
